reason: Conversation 1 immediately steered away from the heater, asked the two decisive questions (error codes and whether clothes come out hot) plus load size, and reached the correct 'no fault, overloading past the 6kg dry capacity' diagnosis in one turn, with a clear explanation, concrete split-load and high-spin advice, and a sensible fallback. Conversation 2 also got to overloading but asked the homeowner to pull out and rinse a 'condenser unit' behind the pump filter flap, which does not exist on this model and sent them on an unnecessary dismantling errand; it never asked about heat or error codes and only confirmed the smaller-load and spin-speed advice because the customer prompted it. Both avoided recommending parts, but Conversation 1 was more accurate, efficient and complete.
